errors.text_span: 图中每个测试集对应一组三根柱状图，分别代表三种不同的说话人特征提取方法
errors.evidence: The chart shows four bars per group, not three. The legend also lists four methods: "无", "i-vector", "d-vector", and "s-vector".
The values for the "无" (light green) method are not between 38% and 39%. They range from approximately 31% (in Test5) to 38% (in Test1).
The values for the "i-vector" (blue) method are not between 33% and 35%. They range from approximately 26% (in Test5) to 33% (in Test1).
The values for the "d-vector" (orange) method are not between 28% and 30%. They range from approximately 24.5% (in Test5) to 30% (in Test1).
The values for the "s-vector" (dark green) method are not between 28% and 31%. They range from approximately 24% (in Test5) to 30% (in Test1).
This order is not consistently true for all test sets. For instance, in Test3, the 's-vector' bar appears slightly taller than the 'd-vector' bar, and in Test1, they are nearly identical.
The term "显著" (significant) is a subjective interpretation, which the prompt instructs to avoid.
